title: When One in Seven NALA Users Wanted Money From Abroad
conflicts: Pivot year: TechCrunch 2021 and the Fintech Leaders interview notes say testing began in 2020 (August 2020), while TechCrunch 2022/2024 and Launch Base say 2021 (the public beta); the story dates the tests to August 2020 and the beta to 2021. The $10M seed is dated to 2021 by Business Daily but announced January 2022 by TechCrunch; story says announced January 2022. Founding 2017 vs 2018; story uses the April 2018 beta. Users: 100,000 downloads (2019) and 250,000 users (TechCrunch 2021) both attributed.
notes: Layoffs and investor reactions rest on Fernandes's own account in the Fintech Leaders show notes (no transcript); attributed to him. Cease-and-desist letter and cut to four staff appear only in paywalled/blocked sources (How We Made It in Africa, Quartz) and were left out. Slate year 2021 adjusted to 2020 (tests began August 2020).
